confounder_definition: Binary history of a Cesarean before the index (analyzed) birth
target_population: Women with a prior delivery (delivery_order >= 2); impossible at the first delivery
converted_RR_if_applicable: n/a -- not converted from another measure
transportability_note: No literature search was performed. A real source must match: NFHS-5-comparable population, institutional-delivery denominator, facility sector split, parity (multiparous only), and time period -- an all-deliveries or all-parity prevalence cannot be substituted without adjustment.
analyst_decision: Grid spans 1-8x RR_UY and 0-30pp prevalence gap among women with a prior delivery, then scales by the common survey-weighted later-delivery share (0.58030987); this is illustrative, not an identified corrected AIPW estimate.
